Overview

Accra is a city in Greater Accra with a population of 2,500,000. Ghana’s vibrant capital on the Atlantic coast, a fast-growing West African hub for business, culture, and diplomacy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 13b growing zone supports Extreme tropical — continuous growing season. Sunshine is limited, with about 133 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
